title: Mconet ModelTarget
description: Language-neutral interaction target that identifies a model service, protocol, model descriptor, optional deployment, and namespaced extensions.
$comment: Copyright © 2026 Mcont. Protocol identity is explicit and must not be inferred from the model name or an access endpoint; access, authorization, task, and execution state are outside this contract.

serviceId.description: Open identifier of the model service being addressed.

protocolId.description: Open identifier of the interaction protocol used for adapter selection.

model.description: Model description independent from service and protocol identity.

modelDescriptor.description: Open model description embedded in a target without adding service or protocol semantics.

name.description: Protocol-facing model name preserved without normalization.

openIdentifier.description: Unicode-friendly open identifier with non-empty period-delimited segments.

jsonPrimitive.description: Primitive value represented directly by JSON.

jsonRecord.description: String-keyed JSON object whose values remain recursively JSON-compatible.
